item.title: Elevate Update: Portal Release Replanned
item.description: The Business Transformation Committee will not proceed with the January 2027 portal release. Employer onboarding will not start in October; a phased release runs December to April.

item.title: Register Your Microsoft Passkey by Friday 2 October
item.description: LeavePlus is turning on Microsoft passkeys across Microsoft 365. Sign in with your face, fingerprint or device PIN instead of a password and a code. Full details on The Hub.
